sv.title: SD vill sänka skatten på bensin och diesel
sv.summary: Sverigedemokraterna vill sänka skatten på bensin och diesel under första halvåret 2027. Det framgår av partiets budgetmotion, som bland annat finansieras genom minskat bistånd.

en.title: The Sweden Democrats want to cut the tax on petrol and diesel
en.summary: The Sweden Democrats want to cut the tax on petrol and diesel during the first half of 2027. This is stated in the party's budget motion, which is partly financed through reduced aid.
